blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – second round MANILA, Philippines—Far Eastern University bolstered its Final Four bid after a 94-83 win over University of the East in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament at Araneta Coliseum on Wednesday. The Tamaraws improved to a 6-4 record, tying La Salle at third. The Red Warriors, on the other hand, crashed to a 0-10 record, dropping their 30th straight game dating back to Season 87 in 2024. “Clearly, we’re happy with where we’re at compared to last year,” said coach Sean Chambers. “Last year at this time, we were struggling to even […]...
